newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ariadne says legal challenge fails.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ariadne says legal challenge fails.

text.p: Investment company and property developer, Ariadne Australia Ltd, said on Friday an appeal against a December 1995 court judgement in its favour had been dismissed withs costs awarded in favour of Ariadne and its co-respondents.

Ariadne, one of the 1980's high-flying entrepeneurial companies, said the favourable judgement completed the end of an era of litigation against the company and would result in a write-back of provisions of about A$16 million.
The write-back would restore the Ariadne group's shareholder's funds to positive, the company said.

With this contingency from legal action removed, the company said it would actively pursue its core activities of investment and property development with an emphasis on cash flow producing investments.
By 2.45 p.m. (0345 GMT), Ariadne shares were 6.5 cents higher at 25 cents on turnover of 140,862 shares.
